proves.claim: A local view that refuses its own page stops retrying and shows one plain open-the-link-again line.

view.cockpit-live.refused-shows-link-lin.why: Without it a refused local page retried silently and the person never learned to open the link again.

proves.claim: A hosted page with a local session still goes round again on a refusal and shows no refusal line.

view.cockpit-live.hosted-refusal-unchang.why: Without it the new local branch could swallow the hosted page's own recovery.
